boxes.title: Run the worker loop
boxes.plain: Ticks until a tick cap is reached or, with stop_when_idle, the queue is empty. Counts how many times each ending happened. A running service sets neither stop.

boxes.title: Run one job
boxes.plain: One pass: reclaim expired leases, claim a job, run the handler, then settle the attempt as done, held, retry, failed or lease_lost.
outputs: an ending name, or None when nothing was ready

boxes.title: Sleep while idle
boxes.plain: When nothing is ready the worker sleeps idle_s seconds and tries again. A job waiting out its backoff looks the same as an empty queue.

boxes.title: Route the parcel
boxes.plain: A declared value over the customs limit without cleared papers is parked, and so is a ZZ postcode. Everything else goes to the carrier.
outputs: a Verdict: label or hold reason

boxes.title: Book the carrier
boxes.plain: A pretend carrier call returns a label like LBL-pw-1. Outage-zone postcodes (99xxx) always raise TransientError.

boxes.title: Lease lost, work dropped
boxes.plain: The worker's lease was gone when it tried to settle, because another claim replaced it. Its result is thrown away so the job is not settled twice.

routes.why: Each loop turn runs process_one once.
process_one always reclaims expired leases before it claims.
After the sleep, the loop continues with its next tick.
declared_cents is above CUSTOMS_LIMIT_CENTS and the parcel has no customs_cleared mark.
The region cannot be verified, so the parcel is parked as an address hold.
No customs or address condition applies.
The carrier call returned a label, so the worker completes the job with it.
The carrier call raised TransientError, so the attempt is recorded as failed.
